The kitchen features wall-mounted cabinets with a shaker style and metallic hardware, complementing the metallic sheen of the island and the glossy ceramic backsplash. The space is well-organized, utilizing the island for additional seating, which is a common practice in contemporary Indian kitchen designs. The lighting is a mix of natural light from the window and artificial light from ceiling fixtures, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere.
